# Requ syntax v0.1

Requ turns one statement per line into SVG workflow or operating-map diagrams.
Packages use @requstory. Language: LANGUAGE.md. Full brief: spec.md.
process <id> "Title" starts a workflow. lane <id> "Label" type=customer|team|agent|external owner="Name" declares an actor. <lane>.<step>: "Label" start|end|decision|wait declares a step. a -> b : "Label" links steps. An org uses team, process <team> "Label", handoff and stage statements. Quote labels; # starts a comment outside quotes. basis=suggested marks unconfirmed content. Diagnostics explain errors with source locations and repair hints. Review model warnings; they do not prove a real operational failure.

Examples:

```requ
process refund "Customer refund"
lane customer "Customer" type=customer
lane support "Support" owner="Support lead"
customer.request: "Request a refund" start
support.review: "Review the request"
customer.receive: "Receive refund" end
request -> review -> receive
```

```requ
process invoice "Invoice approval"
lane supplier "Supplier" type=external
lane agent "Invoice agent" type=agent
lane finance "Finance" owner="Finance lead"
supplier.send: "Submit invoice" start
agent.extract: "Extract invoice details" system="Accounting system"
finance.check: "Invoice valid?" decision
finance.pay: "Approve payment" end
finance.return: "Return for correction" end
send -> extract -> check
check -> pay : "yes"
check -> return : "no"
```

```requ
org "Example SaaS company"
team growth "Growth" owner="Growth lead"
team product "Product" owner="Product lead"
team support "Support" owner="Support lead"
process growth "Attract customers"
process product "Deliver the service"
process support "Resolve issues"
handoff growth -> product : "New customer"
handoff product -> support : "Customer context"
handoff support -> product : "Product feedback"
stage "Discover" : growth
stage "Use" : product
stage "Get help" : support, product
```
